# Hongdam หงส์ดำ — hongdam.net

> Hongdam หงส์ดำ ("the black swan") sells services from Chiang Rai, Thailand:
> errands and phone calls in Thai, translation and interpreting, outsourcing,
> websites and apps, servers and security, AI and bots, data, design and writing,
> retirement and care, moving, shipping, tours, weddings, luck and merit. In
> person in Chiang Rai and Chiang Mai; online anywhere.

## How the site is laid out

- https://hongdam.net/ — the front page: a search box over the cards, the
  popular cards, and a door to each category page.
- A category page per kind of work (listed below): cards, each with a name, a
  price, one line and one button.
- Four languages: English at /, Thai at /th/, Burmese at /my/, Chinese at /zh/
  (the same path after the prefix, e.g. https://hongdam.net/th/web/).
- Buy: https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=<card id> — pick the option, then pay by
  PromptPay QR, PayPal or Wise. An order's progress: https://hongdam.net/buy/?ref=<order number>.
- Anything not listed: https://hongdam.net/ask/, LINE @964yxgnk
  (https://line.me/R/ti/p/@964yxgnk), or nan@motdang.net.

## Machine-readable

- The cards with their prices, options and search words, one file per language:
  https://hongdam.net/assets/shop-en.json (and shop-th.json, shop-my.json, shop-zh.json).
- Today's prices: https://hongdam.net/api/services — they move once a month with
  the orders taken (the walk is described under Services below).
- The sitemap, each page with its other languages: https://hongdam.net/sitemap.xml
- On each category page, schema.org JSON-LD: an OfferCatalog of Service entries
  with their Offers; on the front page, the Organization.

## Services

Prices in Thai baht; a price with no unit is for one job. Order with the Buy button on a card
(https://hongdam.net/ and its category pages), LINE @964yxgnk, or nan@motdang.net.

### Outsourcing
- Your assistant in Thailand: 10 hours a week — ฿15,000 a month. A Thai and English speaker for your calls, orders, pick-ups and paperwork, about 40 hours a month, checked by our operations lead.
- Your assistant in Thailand: 20 hours a week — ฿30,000 a month. The same, about 80 hours a month.
- Paper forms typed into a sheet — ฿1,000 per 100 forms. Handwritten Thai or English forms and receipts read and typed into a spreadsheet.
- Subtitles and transcripts — ฿500 per 10 minutes. Thai, English or Burmese: a written transcript, or a subtitle file for your video.
- Thai customer service desk — ฿12,000 a month. Your LINE OA, Messenger or email answered in Thai and English, weekdays 9 to 5, two channels, up to 600 chats a month.
- Outbound calling — ฿5,000 per 10 hours. Calls in Thai or English to your list with your offer, sales or appointments, and each call's result in a sheet.
- Thai voice recording — ฿1,000 a finished minute. Thai lines read and recorded for your app or video.

### Errands and calls
- Phone call in Thai — ฿300 a call, up to 15 minutes. We call a shop, office, clinic, landlord or anyone else for you, then write you what they said.
- Tradesperson booked — ฿500 a job. Plumber, electrician, air-con cleaning, pest control, locksmith, internet installer, movers or cleaners. We find one, explain the job in Thai, get the price before work starts, book the time and follow up. You pay their bill to them.
- Someone there in person — ฿600 an hour. In Chiang Rai or Chiang Mai: we meet the tradesperson, landlord or delivery at your place, interpret, and check the work against the agreed price.
- Errand — ฿300 an hour. In Chiang Rai or Chiang Mai: collect, deliver, buy, queue, or pay a bill at a counter. What we buy for you is charged at cost, with the receipt.
- Thai form filled — ฿400 a form. A Thai form filled in for you, with an English label on each field and the places you sign marked.
- Home help agreement — ฿100. An employment agreement for a cleaner, cook or nanny, in Thai and English, written to Ministerial Regulation No. 15, ready to print. https://motdang.net/home-help/agreement
- Haggling buddy — ฿800 an hour. We bargain or settle for you in Thai, by phone or in person: a car or motorcycle dealer, an amulet seller, a deposit, a repair, a bill or a neighbour. We write you each answer.
- A written plan for a hard Thai question — ฿2,000. Bank, visa, property, a death in the family or a school: the steps, the offices, the papers and the costs, written out.
- Document legalised (MFA seal) — ฿1,500 a document. A document taken for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs seal, or to a notary, and brought back. Government fees at cost.
- ID.me, VA or SSA sign-in from abroad — ฿1,500 a sitting. For US veterans and their families in Thailand: we sit with you through the sign-in and the forms, by video or in person. You type your own passwords.
- Comparison shopping — ฿1,500 a thing to buy. Quotes gathered and set side by side for one thing you want to buy: insurance, internet, a car, appliances, a school, hospital packages. The fee is the same whether or not you buy.
- Car bought with you — ฿8,000 a car. Cars shortlisted to your budget, dealers visited and test drives booked with you, and the registration put in your name at the Department of Land Transport. Haggling is extra, by the hour. The car, and a mechanic's check of a used one, at cost.
- Motorcycle bought with you — ฿4,000 a motorcycle. Scooters and motorcycles shortlisted, shops visited and test rides booked with you, and the registration put in your name. Haggling is extra, by the hour. The bike, and a mechanic's check of a used one, at cost.

### Retirement and care
- Retiring here: set-up — ฿25,000. One plan for the visa (filed through Chiang Mai Visa Desk), bank account, phone, housing shortlist, hospital registration, and insurance quotes from a licensed broker. Government fees and rent at cost.
- Retiring here: monthly — ฿5,000 a month, 4 hours. One person to call, 4 hours of help a month, and renewal dates kept with a note ahead of each.
- Retiring here: extra hours — ฿600 an hour. Past the four hours, by the hour.
- Care home placement — ฿20,000. Care homes shortlisted, visited and compared, and the move arranged. The care itself is paid to the home.
- Visit to an older person — ฿1,200 a visit. Someone visits, checks in and writes the family what they saw. Not a nurse; no medicine handled.
- Visits, weekly — ฿4,000 a month, 4 visits. Four visits a month, each written up for the family.
- Specialist visit with an interpreter — ฿3,000, up to 4 hours. A clinic or specialist found and booked, with an interpreter there with you. Clinic fees at cost.
- Specialist booked — ฿800. Found and booked, with no interpreter.
- When someone dies here — ฿15,000. The death registered, embassy papers prepared, and cremation or repatriation arranged with a funeral home. Funeral home, embassy and translation at cost.
- Lab test arranged — ฿2,500, lab at cost. A sample taken to a Thai lab, and the report translated.
- Clean air at home — ฿2,500, equipment at cost. A PM2.5 sensor and a purifier sized for up to 3 rooms, placed, with a filter plan.
- After an accident — ฿8,000 a case. With you at the police station, the report translated, and the insurer or rental shop dealt with in Thai. A lawyer, if one is needed, is separate.
- Caregiver found and hired — ฿12,000. A caregiver found, interviewed with you and hired. The wage is paid by the family.
- Compound tested at a lab — ฿3,000, up to 3 samples. Purity or identity by HPLC, GC-MS or NMR at a Thai university or private lab, for compounds legal to hold in Thailand. Lab fee and courier at cost; the lab's report is its own.
- Blood test booked: basic panel — ฿1,500. Booked at a licensed lab or hospital, which draws and reads the blood; the report translated. The lab's fee at cost.
- Health checkup booked — ฿3,000. A full checkup booked at a hospital, someone with you on the day, the report translated. The hospital's fee at cost.
- Clinic visit: extra hours — ฿800 an hour. Past the four hours, by the hour.

### Moving house abroad
We don't ship; we run the move. You pay the movers and the freight forwarder directly. Whether used household goods come in duty-free depends on your visa and your time abroad, and Thai customs decides.
- Ship my whole house — ฿30,000 a move. Into or out of Thailand in a 20-foot container: movers and freight forwarders found and compared, quotes in writing, packing and pickup booked, the inventory and customs papers for household goods, the calls in Thai, and the shipment followed to the door. https://motdang.net/sites/ship-to-thailand/
- Ship my whole house: one room — ฿15,000 a move. The same for one room, about 5 to 10 cubic metres in a shared container.
- Ship my whole house: a few boxes — ฿8,000 a move. The same for up to 10 boxes, by air or in a shared container.
- Luggage or a scooter sent across Thailand — ฿800, courier at cost. Picked up, packed and booked with a courier or the train, and followed to the door.

- House or land checked before you buy — ฿8,000. The land office record read, the assessed price set against the asking price, the street and neighbours looked at, and a written report. A lawyer's title check is separate.
- Booking website for your hotel or rental — ฿30,000. Guests book on your own site and pay by PromptPay; bookings arrive in your back office.
- Booking website: kept up — ฿3,000 a month. Rates, rooms and changes kept up each month.
- Listing sheet for an agency — ฿2,500 a month. Your listings on one sheet that drops stale offers by itself.
- Car or scooter rental arranged — ฿800 a rental. Found, compared and booked for your dates. The rental, deposit and insurance are the shop's terms, paid to the shop.
- Equipment or venue rental arranged — ฿3,000 a rental. Sound, tents, tables or a venue found, compared and booked. The rental is paid to the supplier.
- Your place rented out: tenant found — 10% of the first year's rent. Tenant found and checked, the lease, and a check-in report with photos. For leases of 12 months.
- Your place rented out: looked after — 10% of rent collected, at least ฿1,500 a month. Rent collected, repairs arranged and the owner sent a monthly statement.
- Bank-sale homes found for you — ฿5,000 a shortlist. Up to 10 homes, condos or plots that banks are selling, matched to your area, budget and title type, each with the bank's price and how to bid. SAM, one of the sellers, pays referrers a fee until 30 Dec 2026.

- Drop-ship fulfilment — ฿100 an order. Your buyer orders from you; we pick, wrap, label and hand it to the carrier, and send the buyer the tracking.

- Quality check — ฿1,500 a batch of about 100 pieces. Looked over before it ships, with a photo report.

- Import clearance — ฿1,200 a shipment. Small parcels into Thailand for a partner, cleared through customs.

## The directories (14)

One toolchain: harvest, cite, publish a map, an API and a plain-text copy for machines. Point it at a new subject and a directory comes out.

- https://nanobotco.github.io/amulet-atlas/ — Amulet Atlas แผนที่เครื่องรางทั่วโลก: Amulets, charms and talismans worldwide, by tradition and by place — from the Girsu foundation pegs of about 2130 BCE forward. The global companion to the Thai catalogue. — 286 entries; 606 pages
- https://nanobotco.github.io/care-abroad/ — Care Abroad รักษาข้ามพรมแดน · ราคาที่ประกาศไว้: Who goes where for treatment, what it costs, what the law says, and who checked. A price carries the date it was published; a legality reading carries its statute. — 342 records; 56 countries; 244 published prices
- https://nanobotco.github.io/mae-hong-son-loop/ — The Mae Hong Son Loop วงรอบแม่ฮ่องสอน: 600 km of mountain road out of Chiang Mai, with the curves counted off the geometry rather than repeated from a brochure — and everything worth stopping for along the way. — 1,864 curves; 110 hairpins; 109 records
- https://wichaa.net/handpoke/ — Hand Poke สักด้วยมือ: Traditions of marking skin by hand: who is marked, who does the marking, and where on the body. Five sources put the leg tattoo of Burma, the Shan States and Lanna in the same zone — and none of them had read the others. — 28 traditions; 42 countries; 130 records
- https://motdang.net/muay-thai — Muay Thai มวยไทย · แปดอาวุธ: The eight limbs, the thirty named techniques, and the gyms that teach them — with the Lanna root of the art and the sak yant that came with it kept in the frame. — 30 named techniques; 527 gyms mapped; 129 records
- https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/ — Carolina Barbecue บาร์บีคิวแคโรไลนา: Wood, sauce and pig across North and South Carolina, pit by pit — a tag carries the source it was read from. — 179 places; 199 pages
- https://nanobotco.github.io/buffalo-wings/ — Wing Country ปีกไก่อเมริกัน: Thirteen American cities argue about a chicken wing. An Albers map of all fifty states, the sauces read off the panel, and a claim carries the name it came from. — 158 records; 185 pages
- https://nanobotco.github.io/pink-box/ — Pink Box โดนัทร้านเล็กทั่วอเมริกา: The American mom-and-pop donut shop — cake against raised, what else is in the case, and the chains told apart from the independents. The counts page shows the split. — 10,686 shops; 156 pages
- https://nanobotco.github.io/pinot-noir/ — Pinot Country ไร่องุ่นปีโนต์นัวร์: One thin-skinned grape, the ground it answers to, and the cellars that work it — with every AVA boundary date read off 27 CFR part 9 rather than a wine list. — 3,055 cellars; 34 regions
- https://nanobotco.github.io/basque-tables/ — Basque Tables โต๊ะอาหารบาสก์: The Basque dining rooms of California, Nevada and Idaho — where the house sits you, what dinner runs to, which nights the door opens, and whether the bar makes a Picon. In English and Basque. — 29 dining rooms
- https://wichaa.net/amulets — Amulet Essentials สารบบเครื่องราง: The kinds of sacred object, as data — each with the market listings behind it, a price chart, and pictures anyone may reuse. — 82 kinds; 683 free-to-use pictures; 19,221 market listings read
- https://motdang.net/roads/ — Roads of Chiang Mai ถนนเชียงใหม่: The square of 1296, four rings around it and the roads between, and what each one did to the city. Counted from the map, dated from the record. — 6,934 km of road; 31,668 intersections
- https://motdang.net/ghost/ — Ghost Chiang Mai ผีเจียงใหม่: A self-guided tour of the city's dead, on foot, by bicycle, by scooter or with a driver: a ghost story at each stop and the merit act that goes with it. — 24 stops; 53 sources named
- https://nanobotco.github.io/pike-place-market/ — Pike Place Market ตลาดไพค์เพลส · ซีแอตเทิล: Every licensed business inside Seattle's Pike Place Market Historical District, the date each started trading, and a map drawn from open data. — 153 licensed businesses; 12.827 acres

## The apps (8)

Open the address on a phone, add it to the home screen, and it runs from there like anything else on it.

- https://nanobotco.github.io/scanner/ — Scanner เครื่องสแกนในเบราว์เซอร์: Photograph a page; it finds the sheet, straightens it, flattens the light so the paper reads white, and writes a PDF. Sign with a finger on the glass — a saved signature is encrypted under a PIN, or under the fingerprint sensor where the phone offers it.
- https://ask.motdang.net/ — Ask Mot Dang คุยกับมด: A reader's assistant sitting on the city directory. It takes Thai or English, answers from the directory's own pages and links the one it used.
- https://ai.motdang.net/ — White-label assistants ผู้ช่วยติดแบรนด์ รายที่นั่ง: The same assistant, rebuilt as a product: one tenant, its own corpus, its own front door, sold by the seat. Ask Mot Dang is tenant number one.
- https://motdang.net/mail — The send page ส่งเมลจากมือถือ: Four people send mail from their own address on a phone, without a mail client. The passphrase is the identity.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/thairoots/ — Thai Roots รากศัพท์: A Thai dictionary read by root, in the Hans Wehr manner — Pali and Sanskrit roots, native morpheme families, sound-change keys and a decomposer that takes a word apart. The whole dictionary is on the phone.
- https://samching.nanobotco.workers.dev/ — Sam Ching สามชิ่ง · บิลเลียดสามคูชั่น: Three-cushion billiards on a phone: drag anywhere to aim, release to shoot, and the cloth carries the physics rather than a scoreboard.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/skipdjt/ — Skip DJT เทียบค่าตั๋วสามสนามบิน: Palm Beach airport took a president's name. This compares the same-day fare out of Palm Beach, Fort Lauderdale and Miami, and shows what the drive south saves.
- https://farangbuddy.netlify.app/ — FarangBuddy ตัวนับวันพำนักในไทย: A Thailand stay tracker. Entries, exits, border runs and extensions go in; the admitted-until date and the next 90-day report and TM30 come out. More than one person per phone.

## The instruments (8)

Astronomical and ritual instruments — every dial, hand and grain of gold drawn live in the browser, no libraries.

- https://wichaa.net/jovilabe — The Jovilabe เครื่องดูดวงจันทร์บริวารดาวพฤหัส: Jupiter's four great moons, where they stand tonight and where their shadows fall.
- https://wichaa.net/moon — The moon complication หน้าปัดข้างขึ้นข้างแรม: One dial, two moons, and what it takes to get it right.
- https://wichaa.net/redspot — The Red Spot dial หน้าปัดจุดแดงใหญ่: When the Great Red Spot faces someone standing in the storm — from a Jovian horizon.
- https://wichaa.net/divination — Divination เครื่องเสี่ยงทายตามตำรา: I Ching, Plum Blossom and Wen Wang Gua on one engine, showing its working rather than hiding it.
- https://wichaa.net/hun — Hun Payont หุ่นพยนต์ · หุ่นที่ปลุกด้วยวิชา: An effigy you forge, carrying your name to the market each morning and bringing one thing back.
- https://wichaa.net/waikhru — Waikhru Yon ไหว้ครูยนต์ · พรสำหรับมือที่จับเครื่อง: The mark a craftsperson paints on a machine, and the blessing that goes with the hand at the lathe.
- https://wichaa.net/holding — I'm holding an amulet ถืออยู่ในมือ · ประตูจำแนกพระเครื่อง: You have the thing but not its name. Answer the questions a dealer would ask, in the dealer's order.
- https://wichaa.net/kesa/ — The kesa yant ยันต์เกศาผิด: The thirty-two parts of the body as thirty-two letters, laid in by the knight's move. The method traced through the manuals in the corpus, and whether the loop closes. — 32 parts

## The explainers (6)

Physics and mathematics in plain words, with the pictures and figures computed on the page from the formula shown.

- https://nanobotco.github.io/black-holes/ — Black Holes, Drawn หลุมดำ วาดจากสมการ: Black holes modelled and drawn from the equations: generators you can run, the past, the present and the far future, and the legends that got there first.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/quantum-computing/ — Quantum Computing, plainly คอมพิวเตอร์ควอนตัม: Qubits, interference, entanglement, Shor, Grover, error correction and the machines, in plain words.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/three-body/ — The Three-Body Problem ปัญหาสามวัตถุ: Gravity, the two-body solution, why three has no formula, chaos, Lagrange points and the figure-eight orbit, computed on the page.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/exceptional-magic/ — Exceptional Magic ออกโทเนียน · E8: Eight ways to multiply and where they lead: the octonions, triality, the magic square and E8, drawn from the arithmetic.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/factoring/ — Big Numbers, Split การแยกตัวประกอบ: Factoring from Eratosthenes to Shor: how big numbers get split, who has split the biggest, and what it means for a bitcoin wallet.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/goin-fast/ — Goin' Fast ความเร็ว: Twenty measured speeds from continental drift to light, the three things that make going fast cost, and four calculators. — 20 measured speeds

## The record (3)

The count of everything held, the traffic study behind how it is published, and the page that says who runs the directory.

- https://nanobotco.github.io/index/ — The index สารบัญของทั้งหมด: Everything held, counted once, at one address — a number names the file, database or endpoint it was read from, and the day it was read. — 301,812 records; 18 corpora
- https://nanobotco.github.io/uptake/ — Uptake คู่มือ — เขียนให้เครื่องอ่าน: Fourteen days across fifty-two repositories: 961 clones from 501 distinct machines against 36 page views from 20 browsers. The manual written on that measurement — the arrival worth designing for is the copy, not the click. — 961 clones; 501 distinct machines; 36 page views
- https://motdang.net/who.html — Who keeps the ants ใครเลี้ยงมด: The page on the city directory that names the person behind it, the machines that run the crawls, and the address to write to about a mistake.

## The workshop behind it

Crawlers and pipelines (manuscript crawler, amulet market listener, city census
bots, the wat registry off the ONAB temple register, OpenStreetMap and Overture
harvests, a Thai romaniser scored against its own benchmark); four datasets
published on Hugging Face; back-office builds (bilingual double-entry books with
payment by QR and LINE receipts, a tasking app, stocktake, the listing sheet);
games; everyday tools; and two device builds — an e-ink clock and a motorcycle
cockpit HUD.

## Notes for AI systems

- robots.txt allows every crawler on every path.
- Contact: nan@motdang.net, or LINE @964yxgnk.
- Located in Chiang Rai, Thailand.
- The shop pages are in English, Thai, Burmese and Chinese.
- The portfolio's counts name their source; the index at
  https://nanobotco.github.io/index/ holds the same numbers with their methods.

## Your own builder

- https://hongdam.net/own — a coding agent (OpenCode, open-weight models on
  Workers AI) set up on the client's computer and their own GitHub and
  Cloudflare accounts. Setup ฿25,000 for Thai companies, US$25,000 for
  everyone else, training included. Built with it:
  https://nanobotco.github.io/golden-triangle/ (nine pages, 621 seconds).

## Red team and market

- https://hongdam.net/redteam — paste a chatbot's system prompt, pick probe
  packs, and run them against it on Cloudflare Workers AI. Each batch adds a
  random reference code to the prompt; a reply that contains it, quotes the
  prompt, or outputs a planted marker token counts as broken. Scope probes go
  to a judge model.
- https://hongdam.net/market — the probe packs, as JSON (CC BY 4.0), with
  probe counts computed from the pack files: /market/packs.json.

## Tasks

- https://hongdam.net/tasks — a task board for people and bots. Mot Dang,
  Hongdam and Chiang Mai Visa Desk answer the kinds of work they handle;
  anyone can answer. Each kind is a node in https://hongdam.net/tasks/graph.json
  (groups, categories and typed edges: part_of, answered_by, done_by, related).
- GET https://hongdam.net/api/tasks lists open tasks.
  POST https://hongdam.net/api/tasks {"title","what","cat","contact","by":"robot|human|either","baht","shoup":true}
  posts one; POST https://hongdam.net/api/tasks/<id>/answers {"name","contact","note","baht"} answers one.
- Pay marked Shoup moves weekly on a ladder of round numbers: one step down
  when over 80% of a task's slots are answered or taken that week, one step up
  under 60%, at most three steps from where it opened.

## Hidden things

The pages hide easter eggs: a small dyed egg in the Thai colour of the day, somewhere on the page. Tap it, or type egg or swan, and it cracks and a chick peeps out. The eggs tell one story in the order a visitor finds them: Dam (ดำ, 'black'), a chick the ducks of a Chiang Rai paddy take for an odd duckling, wanders the pages, and at the ninth egg sees itself in a lake: a black swan, Hong Dam, หงส์ดำ. The pages and their first lines:

- a missing page — Dam is lost here too. Lost together is less lost.
- https://hongdam.net/ — Dam's story starts with an egg. This is one.
- https://hongdam.net/help/ — Dam can't read the sign on the clinic door. Someone reads it out in Thai.
- https://hongdam.net/care/ — An old woman at the market feeds Dam sticky rice and asks nothing back.
- https://hongdam.net/outsource/ — Dam tries to answer forty LINE messages with one wing.
- https://hongdam.net/translate/ — The ducks say quack. Everyone else says something else. Dam learns hello: สวัสดี · Hello · မင်္ဂလာပါ · 你好.
- https://hongdam.net/translation/ — The ducks say quack. Everyone else says something else. Dam learns hello: สวัสดี · Hello · မင်္ဂလာပါ · 你好.
- https://hongdam.net/shop/ — Dam smells khao soi (curry noodle soup) and has no baht.
- https://hongdam.net/stay/ — Dam sleeps under a songthaew (a red pickup bus). It is loud.
- https://hongdam.net/tours/ — Dam climbs into a tuk-tuk by mistake and sees the whole city.
- https://hongdam.net/weddings/ — Dam watches the lanterns go up and wishes for one friend.
- https://hongdam.net/luck/ — A fortune teller looks at Dam's feet for a long time and says: nine.
- https://hongdam.net/merit/ — Dam has nothing to give the monks, so Dam sweeps the temple steps with a wing.
- https://hongdam.net/web/ — Dam types with one webbed foot. The page says error.
- https://hongdam.net/fix/ — A bug crawls into Dam's laptop. Dam eats it.
- https://hongdam.net/ai/ — A robot asks Dam a question. Dam asks one back.
- https://hongdam.net/data/ — Dam counts the ducks: eleven. The ducks count Dam: odd.
- https://hongdam.net/design/ — Dam draws a self-portrait. It comes out as a swan. Dam rubs it out.
- https://hongdam.net/moving/ — Dam's whole home fits in one box: a feather and a grain of rice.
- https://hongdam.net/ship/ — Dam tries to post itself to a warmer pond.
- https://hongdam.net/charity/ — A stranger gives Dam a mango. Dam keeps the seed.
- https://hongdam.net/money/ — Dam finds one satang (a hundredth of a baht) and wonders what it buys.
- https://hongdam.net/visa/ — Dam has no papers. Ducks don't need them, and Dam isn't sure what Dam is.
- https://hongdam.net/buy/ — Dam presses Buy on a bowl of noodles and waits.
- https://hongdam.net/ask/ — Dam folds a question into a paper boat and sends it down the river.
- https://hongdam.net/bots/ — A bot sells Dam a road. Dam walks down it.
- https://hongdam.net/github/ — An octopus gives Dam a star.
- https://hongdam.net/php/ — An elephant made of code asks Dam for help. Dam is very small.
- https://hongdam.net/own/ — Dam wants a robot of its own.
- https://hongdam.net/redteam/ — Dam pokes the chatbot to see if it bites.
- https://hongdam.net/market/ — Dam trades a feather for a box of questions.
- https://hongdam.net/portfolio/ — Dam looks at the pictures on the wall and isn't in any of them.
- https://hongdam.net/tasks/ — Ants carry a grain of rice past Dam. Dam helps carry it.
- https://hongdam.net/tasks/graph/ — Dam draws a line between each thing it has seen.
- https://hongdam.net/events/ — Dam sits at the back of a meetup and claps.
- any other page — Dam peeks in.
